name: figma-mcp-json

tools.name: figma_get_file
tools.description: Retrieve a Figma file with all its data including document structure, styles, and components. Use this to access the complete design file content. The fileKey can be found in the Figma file URL (e.g., https://www.figma.com/file/FILE_KEY/file-name).

fileKey.description: The Figma file key (found in the file URL after /file/)

version.description: A specific version ID to get (use figma_get_file_versions to list versions)

ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to retrieve (e.g., "1:5,1:6")

depth.description: Positive integer representing how deep into the document tree to traverse (default is infinity)

geometry.description: Set to "paths" to export vector data

plugin_data.description: Comma-separated list of plugin IDs to include plugin data from

branch_data.description: Returns branch metadata for the file

tools.name: figma_get_file_nodes
tools.description: Retrieve specific nodes from a Figma file by their node IDs. More efficient than getting the entire file when you only need specific elements. Node IDs can be obtained from figma_get_file or from the Figma URL when selecting a node.

nodeIds.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to retrieve (e.g., "1:5,1:6,1:7")

depth.description: How deep to traverse from each node

geometry.description: Set to "paths" to export vector data

tools.name: figma_get_file_versions
tools.description: Get the version history of a Figma file. Returns a list of versions with timestamps, user information, and labels. Useful for accessing previous states of a design or understanding file evolution.

tools.name: figma_get_images
tools.description: Export images from specific nodes in a Figma file. Returns URLs to rendered images of the specified nodes. Supports multiple formats (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF) and scale options. The URLs are temporary and expire after a short time.

nodeIds.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to export as images

use_absolute_bounds.description: Use absolute bounding box for images

tools.name: figma_get_image_fills
tools.description: Get all image fills used in a Figma file. Returns metadata about images including URLs for downloading the actual image files. Useful for extracting all images from a design.

tools.name: figma_get_comments
tools.description: Retrieve all comments from a Figma file. Returns comments with their content, position, author information, and timestamps. Essential for collaboration workflows and review processes.

tools.name: figma_post_comment
tools.description: Create a new comment or reply to an existing comment in a Figma file. Useful for automated feedback, annotations, or integration with other tools. Requires appropriate permissions.

client_meta.description: Position and node information: { x: number, y: number, node_id: string, node_offset: { x: number, y: number } }

node_id.description: The node ID to attach the comment to

comment_id.description: ID of the parent comment if this is a reply

tools.name: figma_delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a specific comment from a Figma file. Requires appropriate permissions and the comment must be owned by the authenticated user.

commentId.description: The unique identifier of the comment to delete

tools.name: figma_get_team_projects
tools.description: List all projects in a Figma team. Returns project names, IDs, and metadata. Use this to discover available projects before fetching their files. Team ID can be found in the Figma team URL or will use FIGMA_TEAM_ID environment variable if not provided (not configured).

teamId.description: The Figma team ID (found in team URL). Optional if FIGMA_TEAM_ID is set in environment.

tools.name: figma_get_project_files
tools.description: Get all files in a specific Figma project. Returns file metadata including names, keys, thumbnails, and last modified dates. Essential for browsing project contents.

projectId.description: The Figma project ID (can be obtained from figma_get_team_projects)

tools.name: figma_get_team_components
tools.description: List all published components in a Figma team. Components are reusable design elements. Returns component metadata including names, descriptions, and containing file information. Team ID will use FIGMA_TEAM_ID environment variable if not provided (not configured).

teamId.description: The Figma team ID. Optional if FIGMA_TEAM_ID is set in environment.

tools.name: figma_get_file_components
tools.description: Get all components defined in a specific Figma file. Returns component metadata including keys, names, descriptions, and node IDs.

tools.name: figma_get_component
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific component by its key. Returns comprehensive information about the component including containing file and thumbnail URL.

tools.name: figma_get_team_component_sets
tools.description: List all component sets (variants) in a Figma team. Component sets group related component variants. Returns metadata about each component set. Team ID will use FIGMA_TEAM_ID environment variable if not provided (not configured).

teamId.description: The Figma team ID. Optional if FIGMA_TEAM_ID is set in environment.

page_size.description: Number of component sets per page

tools.name: figma_get_file_component_sets
tools.description: Get all component sets defined in a specific Figma file.

tools.name: figma_get_component_set
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific component set by its key.

tools.name: figma_get_team_styles
tools.description: List all published styles in a Figma team. Styles include text styles, color styles, effect styles, and grid styles. Returns metadata for each style. Team ID will use FIGMA_TEAM_ID environment variable if not provided (not configured).

teamId.description: The Figma team ID. Optional if FIGMA_TEAM_ID is set in environment.

tools.name: figma_get_file_styles
tools.description: Get all styles defined in a specific Figma file. Returns style metadata including keys, names, descriptions, and style types.

tools.name: figma_get_style
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific style by its key. Returns comprehensive style metadata.

tools.name: figma_get_me
tools.description: Get information about the authenticated user. Returns user profile including ID, email, handle, and avatar URL. Useful for verifying authentication and getting user context.

tools.name: figma_get_dev_resources
tools.description: Get developer resources (links) attached to nodes in a Figma file. Dev resources are external links that developers can attach to design elements for documentation or implementation notes.

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to filter by

tools.name: figma_create_dev_resources
tools.description: Create new developer resources (links) for nodes in a Figma file. Useful for adding documentation links, implementation notes, or references to code.

devResources.description: Array of dev resource objects to create

node_id.description: The node ID to attach the resource to

tools.name: figma_update_dev_resources
tools.description: Update existing developer resources in a Figma file.

devResources.description: Array of dev resource objects to update

tools.name: figma_delete_dev_resources
tools.description: Delete developer resources from a Figma file.

devResourceIds.description: Array of dev resource IDs to delete

tools.name: figma_get_local_variables
tools.description: Get local variables defined in a Figma file. Variables are design tokens that can store colors, numbers, strings, and booleans for consistent design systems.

tools.name: figma_get_published_variables
tools.description: Get published variables from a Figma file. Published variables can be shared across files in a team.

tools.name: figma_post_variables
tools.description: Create or update variables in a Figma file. Variables are powerful for creating design systems with tokens.

variableData.description: Variable data to create or update. Structure depends on variable type (color, number, string, boolean).

tools.name: mcp_list_tools
tools.description: Get a comprehensive list of all available Figma MCP tools along with their complete input schemas and descriptions. Use this for reference when you need to understand what tools are available.
